from sklearn.preprocessing import StandardScaler
scaler = StandardScaler()

from sklearn.ensemble import RandomForestClassifier
import numpy as np
X = sklearn_standard_scaler[:, :-1] if hasattr(sklearn_standard_scaler, 'shape') and len(sklearn_standard_scaler.shape) == 2 else sklearn_standard_scaler
y = sklearn_standard_scaler[:, -1] if hasattr(sklearn_standard_scaler, 'shape') and len(sklearn_standard_scaler.shape) == 2 else sklearn_standard_scaler
y = y.astype(int)
model = RandomForestClassifier()
model.fit(X, y)
sklearn_random_forest_fit = model
import numpy as np
n_features = sklearn_random_forest_fit.n_features_in_
sample_X = np.zeros((5, n_features))
sklearn_model_predict_cell = sklearn_random_forest_fit.predict(sample_X)
import pandas as pd
save_predictions = 'predictions.csv'
pd.DataFrame({'prediction': sklearn_model_predict_cell}).to_csv('predictions.csv', index=False)
